resources.string: What No Tomorrow does with your health data
Body weight in, meals and workouts out. Nothing else is read, and nothing is sent anywhere.
Read, so Progress can chart the weight you already recorded in another app. Written, so a weight you log here shows up in the rest of them.
Written: energy, protein, carbs and fat for every meal you log, with its name and the time of day.
Written: a strength-training session for every workout you finish, and the calories it burned.
Nowhere. Health data stays on this phone: No Tomorrow never uploads it, never shares it and never uses it for advertising. You can withdraw access at any time in Health Connect.
